what: FlexiTac readings of the two pads during the reBot strawberry grasp loop (grasp-*.webm/mp4). ILLUSTRATIVE: simulated, not measured.
model: VT-Refine-style: 12 x 32 taxel points (2 mm pitch) on each pad's deformed outer surface; depth d into the strawberry's signed distance field; reading = clip((d / d_sat - threshold) / (1 - threshold), 0, 1) x 255 (normal only).
note_rate: one map per video frame (the real board sends 100 maps a second)
finger_note: as seen in the video: left = nearer the robot's base (URDF finger_right_link), right = URDF finger_left_link
layout: uint8, [frame - first][finger][row][col]; row 0 = the taxel row nearest the fingertip; col 0 = the column on your left when you look at that pad's face from the strawberry (so the two maps mirror each other, like the two pads facing each other)

camera.note: kit camera: sx = ox + (x sinA - y cosA) ppm, sy = oy + ((x cosA + y sinA) sinE - z cosE) ppm, in the kit frame K = (x, -y, z) of the URDF world, mm

closeup.note: a round close-up of the gripper (same projection, magnified, following the strawberry)
